source: Resident annotated House 55 / 2. OG screenshot supplied in this project on 2026-11-15; registered to Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung LoD2 exterior.

dimensionRefit.basis: Resident-confirmed twenty-room count, general hallway positions and broadly similar single-apartment types with small dimensional variation; approximate 2.70×3.30m living zone in Rommelwood’s older single-apartment sketch.
dimensionRefit.moduleReason: The two explicitly counted exterior runs are approximately 12.066/4 and 9.140/3 metres per bay. The prior dimensional stage used a rounded 3m gross module for W/L. The later resident left-side correction replaces only L with source-anchored bays of about 2.94m; no module is a measured structural grid.
dimensionRefit.changes: Historical stage: equal SW/east divisions, four 3m W bays, three 3m L bays and a fitted common gross depth for seventeen non-R envelopes. Later left-side stage: L moves between source corners with three roughly 2.94m bays; its prior depth boundary is retained. The stairwell, entry and two hall regions are corrected separately. The other seventeen room polygons, including unresolved R, stay byte-identical to the archived dimensional baseline.

commonDepth.stage: Historical dimensional-fit stage, retained reproducibly; not recalculated after the resident left-side correction.
commonDepth.method: Arithmetic mean of the seventeen source-clipped width-only envelope depths in the study axes, minimizing the sum of their squared depth changes with equal per-room weight. Each zone corridor-facing wall is then solved against its source-clipped mean depth; source skew allows small individual differences.
commonDepth.inputStage: Reproducible width-only stage: equal SW/east divisions, 3m W/L bays, N source frontage, approximate original depths. Source-clipped polygons are serialized to six decimals before measuring the retained input vector, as in the prior public study.
commonDepth.scope: Prior seventeen-room fit: A–G, W1–W4, L1–L3 and N1–N3; R excluded. The later left-side correction retains the existing L depth boundary while moving its frontage along the slightly skewed source wall. This historical target is not refitted globally.
commonDepth.interpretation: A fitted gross model depth before walls, not a measured full-apartment template, clear living dimension or rental-area target. Similar dimensions do not establish identical interiors or usable areas. The resident’s hand-length description is qualitative and has not been converted into a measured tolerance.

dimensionRefit.unresolved: R remains about 2.69m gross per bay. Three literal 2.70m clear-width living zones plus walls cannot fit this fixed facade span. Exact full apartment dimensions and equal usable areas remain unproved everywhere.
dimensionRefit.scope: Only index2 is refitted. Lower floors retain the frozen earlier sketch; this candidate is not automatically repeated downwards.

residentCorrections.source: Resident follow-ups on 2026-11-15: twenty top-floor rooms; flush R exterior alignment; then a new left-side image, L1–L3 shifted toward the marked source corners, a narrower stairwell, and a confirmed west-hall entrance into it.

image.interpretation: Annotated orthographic study-axis plot. Blue brackets and arrow request a rightward L1–L3 shift. Red strokes indicate its left boundary and a narrower stair/partition area; green marks the confirmed hallway-to-stairwell entrance below the flight. Pixel strokes are soft constraints, not calibrated measurements.
image.sourceAnchorChoice: Use existing RoofSurface39 vertex18 as the left elbow and vertex3 X as the shared L3/stairwell wall, instead of treating thick freehand pixels as precise coordinates. No second image homography, source rescale or source-vertex change is introduced.

comparisonBaseline.meaning: Frozen top-floor common-depth candidate before the resident's left-side and stairwell correction. Only L1–L3, the stairwell, its entry and hallway topology may change in the next correction. This is not a measured floor plan.

leftSide.depthInterpretation: The previous roughly 5.395m gross model depth is retained, not newly measured or globally refitted. The source-wall skew gives small depth variation after the rightward shift.
leftSide.stairwellWidthInterpretation: The resident said the previous stairwell was too wide and described it as roughly half a room size. Because the clarification concerned width, this study provisionally uses half the adjacent gross bay width. The ratio, clear width and enclosure remain unmeasured.
leftSide.knownConnection: West hall to stairwell through the green-marked entrance on its left wall, below the flight.
leftSide.unknownConnection: No east-hall connection into the stairwell or west hall was supplied. No second stairwell door or bypass route is invented.
leftSide.thickWallQuestion: The handwritten “Thick wall?” remains an unanswered question. No source exterior, wall thickness, structural role or floor area is changed from it.
leftSide.lowerFloorScope: The correction applies only to index2; both lower-floor records retain their earlier frozen sketch extrapolations.

stairs.instruction: Keep the corrected stairwell flush against L3, narrower than before, with the confirmed west-hall entrance below the flight. Its enclosure reaches the north source wall and the southern source corner Y.
stairs.entranceWidthStatus: Illustrative only; resident confirms the location and west-hall-to-stairwell relationship, not the width, exact center, leaf or swing.
stairs.unchanged: Only the schematic flight retains its earlier approximate north/south run. The enclosure now includes clear upper/lower landing areas, and its width and left-wall position have changed.
stairs.unknown: Exact stair flight, number of risers, landing layout, clear widths and any east-hall connection remain unmeasured or unknown.

rightBlock.instruction: Shift R1–R3 toward the stairs until its ends meet the adjoining exterior edges without small corner projections.
rightBlock.correctionMeaning: Outer alignment and three-room count follow the resident correction. Internal divider coordinates and all doorway positions remain estimates.

annotation.observation: Red: room bays and four question-mark zones. Green: two areas explicitly marked as no floor. Blue: central stairs. Lower facade marks are not counted as 2. OG plan divisions.
annotation.reusePermission: Resident supplied the annotation for implementation in rommelweb and explicitly authorized estimates where counts are unknown.

registration.method: Least-squares 8-parameter planar homography from seventeen manually observed same-plane source corners; h33=1.
registration.sourcePlaneMeaning: Visible horizontal roof used only to register plan positions; not the second-floor elevation.

observationCanvas.meaning: Manual digitization canvas; the original image is rescaled to this coordinate grid for the retained observations.

registration.residualMeaning: Fit consistency only. It is not survey accuracy. Hand-drawn strokes, wall thickness, intended boundary placement and the source model remain uncertain.
registration.registrationUncertainty: Approximately 1.1px fit residual at roughly 27px/m; annotate interior positions to no better than several decimetres. No calibrated uncertainty bound is established.

floorGeometry.method: Original horizontal LoD2 envelope section at the unchanged provisional index-2 elevation, minus the complete plan projections of the two resident-marked sloping roof wings.
floorGeometry.elevationStatus: Unchanged roof-height / 3 guide; not a measured storey elevation, and distinct from the roof plane used for registration.
floorGeometry.unassignedMeaning: Source section beyond the annotated flat-roof footprint. Retained in the plate but given no room or circulation function; the screenshot does not resolve these edges.
floorGeometry.numericalCleanup: Polygon clipping uses a 0.00000001 numerical comparison tolerance; isolated remnants below 0.000001m² are discarded. Candidate outer edges extend 0.05m before exact source clipping to avoid numerical circulation gaps along nearly orthogonal source walls; final source exterior vertices are unchanged.
floorGeometry.noOccupancyClaim: Neither shell intersection nor a candidate room polygon proves occupied, rentable, habitable or safe space.

roomInterpretation.confirmationSource: Resident double-check on 2026-11-15: all twenty top-floor rooms, including L1–L3, and their general hallway positions are correct; dimensions must be rechecked.
roomInterpretation.confirmationLimit: Room counts and general hallway positions are resident-confirmed. All twenty fitted room envelopes, divider coordinates, doorways and floor elevations remain unmeasured; study labels are not physical room numbers.
roomInterpretation.markerCountRole: Secondary aggregate crosscheck only; the current count is confirmed directly by the resident rather than inferred from map markers.
roomInterpretation.noRoomNumbers: All identifiers and alphabetic labels are study references; none represent actual physical room numbers or residents.

zoneMeasurements.note: Four rooms are resident-confirmed. Equal gross bays of about 3.02m replace uneven hand-stroke divisions. Their corridor-facing wall moves to the common fitted gross depth; these are not measured full apartments or physical room numbers. The shared fitted gross depth is approximately 5.40m before walls; it is not a measured clear apartment depth.

Three rooms are resident-confirmed. Equal gross bays of about 3.05m replace uneven hand-stroke divisions. Their corridor-facing wall moves to the common fitted gross depth. Kitchen, bathroom, wall thicknesses and usable areas remain unknown. The shared fitted gross depth is approximately 5.40m before walls; it is not a measured clear apartment depth.

Four rooms are resident-confirmed. Candidate 3.00m gross bays and a common fitted gross depth use some former corridor space. These similar envelope dimensions are a model assumption, not a measured full-apartment template. The shared fitted gross depth is approximately 5.40m before walls; it is not a measured clear apartment depth.

Three rooms L1–L3 and their rightward shift are resident-confirmed. Their left edge follows the source northern elbow and L3 meets the stairwell wall above the southern source corner. Equal gross bays are about 2.94m wide; the previous approximately 5.40m gross depth is retained. These are unmeasured candidate envelopes, not exact apartment dimensions or physical room numbers.

Three rooms and the flush exterior alignment are resident-confirmed. The retained facade is about 8.08m long: roughly 2.69m gross per bay, before walls. Three literal 2.70m clear-width templates cannot fit this fixed span. This block is unresolved; no narrower real apartment type or invented wall thickness is asserted.

Three rooms are resident-confirmed. Source-anchored gross bays remain about 3.19m wide; only their corridor-facing boundary moves to the common fitted gross depth. All internal positions and clear dimensions remain estimates. The shared fitted gross depth is approximately 5.40m before walls; it is not a measured clear apartment depth.

lowerFloorExtrapolation.method: Resident-requested repetition of the current corrected 2. OG core. The former frozen sketch is superseded on this floor; every copied space and doorway remains estimated.
lowerFloorExtrapolation.floorPlateSource: This lower floor retains its preceding complete LoD2 source section byte-for-byte, including its own holes and extensions.
lowerFloorExtrapolation.unassignedMeaning: Additional lower-floor wings and unused edge areas have no invented rooms, corridor routes, staircase connections or use classification.
lowerFloorExtrapolation.exteriorTrimMeaning: Only sub-millimetre source-edge differences are clipped. Shared interior geometry, the schematic flight and doorway segments repeat the current top-floor study.
lowerFloorExtrapolation.noOccupancyClaim: Twenty repeated study references are not a complete or confirmed lower-floor room count, room-number inventory, measured layout or occupancy statement.

outputContract.levels: All three study levels, in order EG/index0, 1. OG/index1, 2. OG/index2.
outputContract.approvalStatus: All are unmeasured study records; none creates an approved interior or a measured elevation anchor.

windows.elevationPolicy: The exterior uses the established appearance-only old-house row guides and typical-sketch sill/height. The plan uses a low display cutaway; neither establishes measured elevations.

wallOffsets.basis: A transparent 0.20m sensitivity case for the resident’s arrows and finite-wall hypothesis. Not digitized as a dimension, not derived from hand length, and not optimized to make the R template fit.

wallOffsets.whatCanOverlap: Different projected façade/roof edges and gross wall allocations may overlap visually. Independent room, stair and hall floor polygons must remain disjoint.
wallOffsets.limitation: Source LoD2 contains exterior faces, not paired inner faces or wall assemblies. Its stepped extra floor-section margins occur at other roof ends; they do not establish extra width in the R façade. The wall hypothesis is not verified by the source.
wallOffsets.numericalCleanup: L exterior edges clip against both original floor and roof constraints. Hall boundaries retain every adjoining serialized room corner. A 0.000002m schematic-flight inset avoids serialization slivers; it is not architectural clearance.

reference.meaning: Extend the resident-marked vertical exterior return north through the flight; do not use a moved room divider as the reference.

observedRatio.clarification: Resident explicitly answered “R1 side — left in Image 3” for the three-quarter portion. This later clarification resolves the initial left/right wording.

overlap.meaning: Equal signed perpendicular offset at the façade corners. Confirmed relative alignment; not a measurement of masonry thickness.

stairGeometry.derivation: Keep the prior equal L bay widths; place L1 at the W4-matched corner offset; L3 ends at the west stair wall. The reference lies one quarter of the derived full width from that wall. Both sides parallel the reference.

stairAlignment.limitations: The tiny alignment shear follows source-edge skew. Exact L sizes remain prior estimates; the derived gross stair width is conditional on them. Landings, clear widths, wall assemblies and the east stair connection remain unmeasured.

parameters.targetInterpretation: Conditional internal-envelope benchmark, borrowed from the published 16.4m² average. It is not proof of the rental area, clear area or individual room dimensions.
parameters.guardInterpretation: Geometric study guard only, not a legal or accessibility-compliance claim.
parameters.internalPartitions: Bathroom, kitchenette and other internal partition footprints are unknown and are not deducted. The internal envelope is not certified usable floor area.

areaStudy.limitations: Area and masonry inputs remain unverified. Existing service partitions are unknown. The R target does not fit under these fixed-frontage/connector assumptions; more depth cannot resolve its separate clear-width concern. Gross model envelopes, conditional internal envelopes and rental/usable floor area must not be conflated.

alignment.interpretation: Align the two existing estimated side-wall lines to the two endpoints of the opposite recess. Retain their small prior slopes, use equal interpolated bays, and keep the source-facing R plane unchanged.
alignment.markerMeaning: Estimated R-bank extent. It is distinct from the unchanged shorter source shell edge and from clear apartment widths.

staircase.rightOnlyShrinkConflict: With the west edge fixed, the L3-side reference distance is fixed. Reducing total width increases its fraction above the existing 25%, so it cannot yield 20–25%. The gross enclosure therefore stays fixed; the flight receives equal explicit side insets.

unassigned.meaning: Narrow residual strip and connected blind end pocket removed from circulation; service is a schema category, not an assertion of installed services.

earlierLowerFloorExtrapolation.exteriorTrimMeaning: Shared interior dividers and opening coordinates are retained. Outer space edges are clipped to this floor’s own source outline; sub-millimetre roof/ground quantization differences are not resolved by changing official vertices.
